AGENTS.md.does: pi's global instructions — the rules every session on this machine follows

agents/reviewer-fable.md.does: `reviewer-fable` subagent: read-only code reviewer pinned to claude-fable-5-1

agents/reviewer-kimi.md.does: `reviewer-kimi` subagent: read-only code reviewer pinned to kimi-k3 (Fireworks)

agents/scout-kimi.md.does: `scout-kimi` subagent: read-only recon, writes context.md for handoff

agents/worker-kimi.md.does: `worker-kimi` subagent: end-to-end implementer for bounded tasks, on kimi-k3

extensions/auto-update.ts.does: `/update`: pi + package self-update and reload; also daily on session start

extensions/btw.ts.does: `/btw <q>`: side question answered inline, outside the main model's context

extensions/compaction-fallback.ts.does: compaction-fallback: on summary failure, retry once cross-family, then restore

extensions/done.ts.does: `/done`: archive this session out of the `/resume` list and quit (still on disk)

extensions/herdr-agent-name.ts.does: herdr-agent-name: session name → herdr slug; sidebar, tab and intercom share it

extensions/herdr-agent-state.ts.does: herdr-agent-state: reports working/blocked/idle to the sidebar over its socket

extensions/md.ts.does: `/md [path]`: render a markdown file inline; no arg = last .md the agent named

extensions/pr-footer.ts.does: `⚑ N need review` in the pi footer, from pr-watch's cache (never calls GitHub)

extensions/pr-review.ts.does: `open_pr_review` tool: opens your PR in a herdr Neovim + octo.nvim tab

extensions/preset.ts.does: `/preset <name>`: switch model, thinking, tools and prompt as one named bundle

ghostty/config.ghostty.does: tribble's Ghostty config: Catppuccin Mocha, JetBrains Mono 15pt, fish + cmd keys

mcp.json.does: tribble's MCP servers for pi-mcp-adapter (Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear, …)

mise.toml.does: mise.toml: pins node 24 + typescript for the `tsc -p tsconfig.json` typecheck

models.json.does: tribble's model catalog for cloudflare-ai-gateway: Fireworks, Anthropic, GPT

prompts/extract-process-improvements.md.does: `/extract-process-improvements`: fold durable lessons into AGENTS.md, or nothing

prompts/start-ticket.md.does: `/start-ticket <LINEAR-ID>`: Linear → `ws create` + agent that shapes and waits

skills/shape/SKILL.md.does: `shape` skill: user approves a mock of the result before any build

settings.json.does: pi's main settings — tribble's: model routing, packages, subagent models

tsconfig.json.does: tsconfig.json: `tsc -p` typecheck of extensions against pi's types via .pi-types

bin/agent-costs.does: `agent-costs [--days N]`: per-model median cost, turns, tokens and shares

cloak.json.does: pi-cloak config: masks .env, auth.json and token-shaped strings before the model

configs/ws.json.does: tribble's repo map for `/ws`: short id → local checkout path (workos, infra)

themes/calm-tribble.json.does: pi TUI theme `calm-tribble`: dark steel-blue with sage and sand accents
